name: Shishak
title: The Prophet Who Warned the Kings of Judah
summary: Shishak (also called Shemaiah) was a prophet and historian in the kingdom of Judah during the reigns of King Rehoboam and Abijah. He is known for recording the deeds of Rehoboam and Abijah in his chronicles. He delivered God's word to the kings of Judah during a critical period after the division of the kingdom.

keyEvents.title: Record of Rehoboam's Deeds
keyEvents.description: Shishak was one of the prophets who recorded King Rehoboam's history and deeds in his chronicles, serving as a historical chronicler for the kingdom of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Genealogies in His Writings
keyEvents.description: Shishak's writings contained genealogies and historical records that were used as sources for the Books of Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Record of Abijah's Deeds
keyEvents.description: Shishak also documented King Abijah's history and his actions, thereby helping to preserve the royal history of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Ministry During the Division of the Kingdom
keyEvents.description: Shisha served as a prophet during the turbulent period after the united kingdom was divided into Judah and Israel, witnessing the dramatic events that followed.

keyEvents.title: Prophetic Testimony Regarding God's Judgment
keyEvents.description: During the time when Rehoboam abandoned the law of Jehovah, prophets like Shisha were active in delivering God's message of judgment and repentance to the people of Judah.
